CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.
   C. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   C. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Judge Deborah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Judge Deborah.
   B. Use Judge Deborah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Judge Deborah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Judge Deborah has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   B. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus’ Encounter with Jesus Christ.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   B. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.
   D. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Gifts of the Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
